shloka_text: प्रस्थाप्य तु स शत्रुघ्नं भ्रातृभ्यां सह राघवः । प्रमुमोद सुखी राज्यं धर्मेण परिपालयन् ।। 7.73.1 ।।
transliteration: prasthāpya tu sa śatrughnaṃ bhrātṛbhyāṃ saha rāghavaḥ | pramumoda sukhī rājyaṃ dharmeṇa paripālayan || 7.73.1 ||
translation: प्रस्थाप्य having sent off, तु indeed, सः he, शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, भ्रातृभ्याम् with his two brothers, सह with, राघवः Rama, प्रमुमोद rejoiced, सुखी happy, राज्यम् the kingdom, धर्मेण righteously, परिपालयन् ruling.
explanation: Having sent off Shatrughna, Rama, accompanied by his two brothers, happily rejoiced while ruling the kingdom righteously.
comments: An old brahmin comes to the palace gate bearing his dead son, lamenting that in Rama's kingdom his only child has died untimely, a thing unheard of -- he charges that some fault of the king must have caused it and demands the boy be revived, vowing that he and his wife will die at the gate and leave Rama guilty of a brahmin's death.

shloka_text: ततः कतिपयाहःसु वृद्धो जानपदो द्विजः । मृतं बालमुपादाय राजद्वारमुपागमत् ।। 7.73.2 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ katipayāhaḥsu vṛddho jānapado dvijaḥ | mṛtaṃ bālamupādāya rājadvāramupāgamat || 7.73.2 ||
translation: ततः then, कतिपयाहःसु after a few days, वृद्धः an old man, जानपदः a citizen, द्विजः a Brahmin, मृतम् dead, बालम् child, उपादाय having taken, राजद्वारम् to the royal gate, उपागमत् approached.
explanation: Then, after a few days, an old Brahmin citizen, holding his dead child, approached the royal gate.

shloka_text: रुदन्बहुविधा वाचः स्नेहदुःखसमन्विताः । असकृत्पुत्र पुत्रेति वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.73.3 ।।
transliteration: rudanbahuvidhā vācaḥ snehaduḥkhasamanvitāḥ | asakṛtputra putreti vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.73.3 ||
translation: रुदन् weeping, बहुविधाः various kinds of, वाचः words, स्नेहदुःखसमन्विताः filled with affection and sorrow, असकृत् repeatedly, पुत्र O son!, पुत्र O son!, इति thus, वाक्यम् words, एतत् this, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.
explanation: Weeping, he uttered various words filled with affection and sorrow, repeatedly exclaiming, "O son, O son!"

shloka_text: किं नु मे दुष्कृतं कर्म पुरा देहान्तरे कृतम् । यदहं पुत्रमेकं त्वां पश्यामि निधनं गतम् ।। 7.73.4 ।।
transliteration: kiṃ nu me duṣkṛtaṃ karma purā dehāntare kṛtam | yadahaṃ putramekaṃ tvāṃ paśyāmi nidhanaṃ gatam || 7.73.4 ||
translation: किम् what, नु indeed, मे by me, दुष्कृतम् evil, कर्म deed, पुरा formerly, देहान्तरे in another body, कृतम् done, यत् that, अहम् I, पुत्रम् son, एकम् only one, त्वाम् you, पश्यामि I see, निधनम् death, गतम् gone to.
explanation: He lamented, "What evil deed did I commit in a previous birth that I now see you, my only son, having met your death?"

shloka_text: अप्राप्तयौवनं बालं पञ्चवर्षसहस्रकम् । अकाले कालमापन्नं मम दुःखाय पुत्रक ।। 7.73.5 ।।
transliteration: aprāptayauvanaṃ bālaṃ pañcavarṣasahasrakam | akāle kālamāpannaṃ mama duḥkhāya putraka || 7.73.5 ||
translation: अप्राप्तयौवनं one who has not attained youth, बालं child, पञ्चवर्षसहस्रकम् of five thousand years (age), अकाले untimely, कालम् death, आपन्नं attained, मम my, दुःखाय for sorrow, पुत्रक O son
explanation: The child, though five thousand years old, had not yet reached youth and met an untimely death, causing great sorrow to the speaker.

shloka_text: अल्पैरहोभिर्निधनं गमिष्यामि न संशयः । अहं च जननी चैव तव शोकेन पुत्रक ।। 7.73.6 ।।
transliteration: alpairahobhirnidhanaṃ gamiṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ | ahaṃ ca jananī caiva tava śokena putraka || 7.73.6 ||
translation: अल्पैः in a few, अहोभिः days, निधनं death, गमिष्यामि I shall attain, न no, संशयः doubt, अहं I, च and, जननी mother, च and, एव indeed, तव your, शोकेन by sorrow, पुत्रक O son
explanation: The speaker and the mother will undoubtedly die within a few days due to the grief over the son's death.

shloka_text: न स्मराम्यनृतं ह्युक्तं न च हिंसां स्मराम्यहम् । सर्वेषां प्राणिनां पापं कृतं नैव स्मराम्यहम् ।। 7.73.7 ।।
transliteration: na smarāmyanṛtaṃ hyuktaṃ na ca hiṃsāṃ smarāmyaham | sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ naiva smarāmyaham || 7.73.7 ||
translation: न not, स्मरामि I remember, अनृतं untruth, हि indeed, उक्तं spoken, न not, च and, हिंसां violence, स्मरामि I remember, अहम् I, सर्वेषां of all, प्राणिनां beings, पापं sin, कृतं done, न not, एव indeed, स्मरामि I remember, अहम् I
explanation: The speaker asserts that he does not recall ever speaking an untruth, committing violence, or performing any sin against any living being.

shloka_text: केनाद्य दुष्कृतेनायं बाल एव ममात्मजः । अकृत्वा पितृकार्याणि गतो वैवस्वतक्षयम् ।। 7.73.8 ।।
transliteration: kenādya duṣkṛtenāyaṃ bāla eva mamātmajaḥ | akṛtvā pitṛkāryāṇi gato vaivasvatakṣayam || 7.73.8 ||
translation: केन by what, अद्य today, दुष्कृतेन evil deed, अयं this, बालः child, एव indeed, मम my, आत्मजः son, अकृत्वा without performing, पितृकार्याणि filial duties, गतः gone, वैवस्वतक्षयम् to the abode of Yama
explanation: The speaker wonders what sin he committed that his son, still a child, has died without fulfilling his duties to his ancestors.

shloka_text: नेदृशं दृष्टपूर्वं मे श्रुतं वा घोरदर्शनम् । मृत्युरप्राप्तकालानां रामस्य विषये यथा ।। 7.73.9 ।।
transliteration: nedṛśaṃ dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ me śrutaṃ vā ghoradarśanam | mṛtyuraprāptakālānāṃ rāmasya viṣaye yathā || 7.73.9 ||
translation: न not, ईदृशं such, दृष्टपूर्वं seen before, मे by me, श्रुतं heard, वा or, घोरदर्शनम् terrible sight, मृत्युः death, अप्राप्तकालानां of those whose time has not come, रामस्य Rama's, विषये in the kingdom, यथा as
explanation: The speaker states that he has never before seen or heard of such a terrible sight as the untimely death of those in Rama's kingdom.

shloka_text: रामस्य दुष्कृतं किञ्चिन्महदस्ति न संशयः । यथा हि विषयस्थानां बालानां मृत्युरागतः ।। 7.73.10 ।।
transliteration: rāmasya duṣkṛtaṃ kiñcinmahadasti na saṃśayaḥ | yathā hi viṣayasthānāṃ bālānāṃ mṛtyurāgataḥ || 7.73.10 ||
translation: रामस्य Rama's, दुष्कृतं misdeed, किञ्चित् some, महत् great, अस्ति is, न no, संशयः doubt, यथा just as, हि indeed, विषयस्थानां of those living in the kingdom, बालानां of children, मृत्युः death, आगतः has come.
explanation: There is no doubt that Rama has committed some great sin, just as death has come upon the children living in his kingdom.

shloka_text: नह्यन्यविषयस्थानां बालानां मृत्युतो भयम् । त्वं राजञ्जीवयस्वैनं बालं मृत्युवशं गतम् ।। 7.73.11 ।।
transliteration: nahyanyaviṣayasthānāṃ bālānāṃ mṛtyuto bhayam | tvaṃ rājañjīvayasvainaṃ bālaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ gatam || 7.73.11 ||
translation: न not, हि indeed, अन्यविषयस्थानां of those living in other kingdoms, बालानां of children, मृत्युतः from death, भयम् fear, त्वं you, राजन् O King, जीवयस्व revive, एनं this, बालं child, मृत्युवशं under the sway of death, गतम् gone.
explanation: Indeed, children in other kingdoms do not fear death, so O King, you must revive this child who has fallen under the sway of death.

shloka_text: राजद्वारि मरिष्यामि पत्न्या सार्धमनाथवत् । ब्रह्महत्यां ततो राम समुपेत्य सुखी भव ।। 7.73.12 ।।
transliteration: rājadvāri mariṣyāmi patnyā sārdhamanāthavat | brahmahatyāṃ tato rāma samupetya sukhī bhava || 7.73.12 ||
translation: राजद्वारि at the king's gate, मरिष्यामि I will die, पत्न्या with my wife, सार्धम् together, अनाथवत् like an orphan, ब्रह्महत्यां the sin of killing a Brahmin, ततः then, राम O Rama, समुपेत्य having incurred, सुखी happy, भव be.
explanation: I will die at the king's gate with my wife, like a helpless person, and then, O Rama, having incurred the sin of killing a Brahmin, you may be happy.

shloka_text: भ्रातृभिः सहितो राजन्दीर्घमायुरवाप्स्यसि । उषिताः स्म सुखं राज्ये तवास्मिन्सुमहाबल ।। 7.73.13 ।।
transliteration: bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito rājandīrghamāyuravāpsyasi | uṣitāḥ sma sukhaṃ rājye tavāsminsumahābala || 7.73.13 ||
translation: भ्रातृभिः with brothers, सहितः accompanied, राजन् O King, दीर्घम् long, आयुः life, अवाप्स्यसि you will obtain, उषिताः we have lived, स्म (past tense indicator), सुखं happily, राज्ये in the kingdom, तव your, अस्मिन् in this, सुमहाबल O greatly powerful one.
explanation: O King, accompanied by your brothers, you will obtain a long life; O greatly powerful one, we have lived happily in your kingdom until now.

shloka_text: इदं तु पतितं तस्मात्तव राम वशे स्थिताः । कालस्य वशमापन्नाः स्वल्पं हि नहि नः सुखम् ।। 7.73.14 ।।
transliteration: idaṃ tu patitaṃ tasmāttava rāma vaśe sthitāḥ | kālasya vaśamāpannāḥ svalpaṃ hi nahi naḥ sukham || 7.73.14 ||
translation: इदं this, तु but, पतितं has fallen, तस्मात् therefore, तव your, राम O Rama, वशे under control, स्थिताः being, कालस्य of time, वशम् control, आपन्नाः having fallen into, स्वल्पं little, हि indeed, नहि not at all, नः our, सुखम् happiness.
explanation: But this misfortune has now befallen us, O Rama, who are under your control, as we have fallen under the sway of time, and indeed, our happiness is now very little.

shloka_text: सम्प्रत्यनाथो विषय इक्ष्वाकूणां महात्मनाम् । रामं नाथमिहासाद्य बालान्तकरणं ध्रुवम् ।। 7.73.15 ।।
transliteration: sampratyanātho viṣaya ikṣvākūṇāṃ mahātmanām | rāmaṃ nāthamihāsādya bālāntakaraṇaṃ dhruvam || 7.73.15 ||
translation: सम्प्रति now, अनाथः helpless, विषयः kingdom, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of the Ikshvakus, महात्मनाम् of the great-souled ones, रामम् Rama, नाथम् as protector, इह here, आसाद्य having obtained, बालान्तकरणम् causing the death of children, ध्रुवम् certainly.
explanation: Now, this kingdom of the great Ikshvakus, having obtained Rama as its protector, is certainly causing the death of children.

shloka_text: राजदोषैर्विपद्यन्ते प्रजा ह्यविधिपालिताः । असद्वृत्ते तु नृपतावकाले म्रियते जनः ।। 7.73.16 ।।
transliteration: rājadoṣairvipadyante prajā hyavidhipālitāḥ | asadvṛtte tu nṛpatāvakāle mriyate janaḥ || 7.73.16 ||
translation: राजदोषैः by the faults of the king, विपद्यन्ते perish, प्रजाः subjects, हि indeed, अविधिपालिताः not protected according to law, असद्वृत्ते when ill-behaved, तु but, नृपतौ when the king, अकाले untimely, म्रियते dies, जनः people.
explanation: Indeed, subjects not protected according to law perish due to the king's faults, and when the king is ill-behaved, people die untimely deaths.

shloka_text: यद्वा पुरेष्वयुक्तानि जना जनपदेषु च । कुर्वते न च रक्षा ऽस्ति तदा कालकृतं भयम् ।। 7.73.17 ।।
transliteration: yadvā pureṣvayuktāni janā janapadeṣu ca | kurvate na ca rakṣā 'sti tadā kālakṛtaṃ bhayam || 7.73.17 ||
translation: यद्वा or when, पुरेषु in cities, अयुक्तानि improper acts, जनाः people, जनपदेषु in districts, च and, कुर्वते do, न not, च and, रक्षा protection, अस्ति is, तदा then, कालकृतम् caused by time, भयम् fear.
explanation: Or when people commit improper acts in cities and districts, and there is no protection, then there is fear caused by the times.

shloka_text: सुव्यक्तं राजदोषो हि भविष्यति न संशयः । पुरे जनपदे चापि ततो बालवधो ह्ययम् ।। 7.73.18 ।।
transliteration: suvyaktaṃ rājadoṣo hi bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | pure janapade cāpi tato bālavadho hyayam || 7.73.18 ||
translation: सुव्यक्तम् very clearly, राजदोषः a king's fault, हि indeed, भविष्यति will be, न no, संशयः doubt, पुरे in the city, जनपदे in the district, च and, अपि also, ततः therefore, बालवधः child-killing, हि indeed, अयम् this.
explanation: It is very clear that there will be no doubt of a king's fault in the city and the district, and therefore, this child-killing is indeed due to that.

shloka_text: एवं बहुविधैर्वाक्यैरुपरुध्य मुहुर्मुहुः । राजानं दुःखसन्तप्तः सुतं तमुपगूहते ।। 7.73.19 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ bahuvidhairvākyairuparudhya muhurmuhuḥ | rājānaṃ duḥkhasantaptaḥ sutaṃ tamupagūhate || 7.73.19 ||
translation: एवम् thus, बहुविधैः of many kinds, वाक्यैः with words, उपरुध्य having importuned, मुहुर्मुहुः repeatedly, राजानम् the king, दुःखसन्तप्तः afflicted with sorrow, सुतम् son, तम् him, उपगूहते embraces.
explanation: Thus, repeatedly importuning the king with various kinds of words, the father, deeply distressed, clasps his son. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रिसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 73 ।। Thus ends the seventy-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
